title: CGC Landran
intro: Official facts come from cgc.edu.in. Items marked 'not confirmed' come from the project's older stored data. Fees, courses and scholarships are answered by the chatbot's programme-aware answers.

topics.title: About CGC Landran
topics.answer: Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC) Landran is in Sector 112, Landran, Mohali, Punjab. Per the official site it was established in 2001 and offers 55+ UG and PG programmes; the Admissions page states NAAC A+ accreditation.
topics.unconfirmed:
Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC) Landran, established in 2001, is located in Sector 112, Landran, Greater Mohali, Punjab (near Chandigarh). CGC Landran is accredited with NAAC A+ Grade and several engineering and pharmacy programs are NBA accredited. It is affiliated with I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University (IKGPTU), Jalandhar for technical, management, pharmacy, and computer applications programs, and approved by AICTE and PCI. The campus spans over 45 acres with state-of-the-art academic blocks, research labs, centralized library, incubation centers, and residential hostels.

Help-desk data: Chandigarh College of Technology (CCT), Landran is part of CGC. Director Principal: Dr. Palki Sahib Kaur. Affiliation: IKGPTU, AICTE, NAAC A+.

topics.title: Constituent Colleges & Departments at CGC Landran
topics.answer:
Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC) Landran comprises the following constituent colleges and departments:

1. **Chandigarh Engineering College (CEC)**
   - Programs: B.Tech (CSE, AI & ML, ECE, ME, Robotics) & M.Tech

2. **CGC College of Engineering (COE)**
   - Programs: B.Tech Programs

3. **Chandigarh College of Technology (CCT)**
   - Programs: BCA, B.Sc Multimedia, Biotechnology, Microbiology, MCA, M.Sc

4. **Chandigarh Business School of Administration (CBSA)**
   - Programs: BBA, B.Com (Hons), MBA, M.Com

5. **Chandigarh College of Pharmacy (CCP)**
   - Programs: B.Pharm, Pharm.D, M.Pharm, D.Pharm

6. **Chandigarh College of Hospitality (CCH)**
   - Programs: BHMCT, BTTM, B.Sc HHA, Nutrition & Dietetics

topics.title: Admission information
topics.answer: The official Admissions page shows 4 steps: 1) Apply on the website, 2) Register with your details, 3) Fill the form and pay, 4) Upload documents and submit. Eligibility is not listed there; check the programme page or call helpline 1800-200-3575.
topics.unconfirmed:
Admission Guidelines at CGC Landran:
- Application Process: Online registration via official portal https://www.cgc.edu.in or offline visit to Admission Block, CGC Landran.
- Eligibility Criteria:
  * B.Tech: Passed 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and one optional subject with minimum 45% marks (40% for reserved categories) and valid JEE Main score or State merit counselling.
  * BCA: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved category) with Mathematics/Computer Science/IT preferred.
  * BBA / B.Com: 10+2 in any recognized stream with at least 50% aggregate marks.
  * B.Pharm: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics with minimum 50% marks.
  * MBA / MCA: Bachelor’s degree of minimum 3-year duration with at least 50% marks from a recognized university.
- Documents Required: 10th & 12th Marksheets, Graduation degree (for PG), Migration Certificate, Character Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card, Passport photographs.
- Note: Tuition fees, scholarships (e.g. Josh Scholarship, Post-Matric schemes), and seat quotas are subject to PTU & State Government counselling notifications. For fee details, students must consult official admissions counsellors at 1800 200 3575.

Help-desk data: admission portal admission.cgc.edu.in; email admissions@cgc.edu.in.

topics.title: Academic information
topics.answer: CGC programmes are taught under university affiliation (see the PTU section) and some programmes run under autonomous status per the official B.Tech CSE page. Use the Academic section for course, semester and subject details.

topics.answer: CGC's Admissions and home pages state 10,000+ placement offers, 1,300+ recruiting companies and a highest package of ₹1.14 Cr per annum. Programme pages quote their own figures (the B.Tech CSE page cites 22 LPA for Batch 2026).
